description: Environmental Planning Instrument - Landslide Risk is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure. This spatial dataset identifies land where development implications exist due to the Landslide Risk for certain areas as designated by the relevant NSW environmental planning instrument (EPI). The Environmental Planning Instrument (EPI) contains provisions relating to landslide susceptibility conditions and identifies the how risks of development are managed. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure. Its tags are EPI, HAZARDS-Landslip, HUMAN-ENVIRONMENT-Planning, LEP, Landslide. It offers 6 resource(s) in arcgis rest service, json, pdf, txt, wfs. The portal shows 2025-10-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
